item.title: ICE retracts claim of purchasing Orange County facility for new immigration detention center
item.description: ICE retracted its claim of purchasing an Orange County warehouse to repurpose as a detention center, but defended its immigration enforcement operations and released details of several undocumented people recently arrested in New York.
